title: The Clouds Are Alive
youtube_title: In This Roblox Town, Clouds Are Alive...
tiktok_caption: Never let your cloud touch the ground. ☁️👀
thumbnail_rec: Chloe in a light-blue hoodie under a giant pink cloud with an open mouth, the sky full of clouds opening their eyes and a vast mother-cloud shadow above.

lines.text: In this town, clouds are living creatures.
They sleep above the rooftops.
They eat sunlight.
And sometimes, they follow people home.
Everyone has their own cloud.
But there's one rule.
Never let your cloud touch the ground.
A girl named Chloe had a tiny pink cloud that followed her everywhere.
Until one morning, it started growing.
By lunchtime, it was bigger than her house.
By sunset, it covered the entire neighborhood.
Then it began descending.
Chloe ran outside and shouted for it to stop.
But the cloud kept falling.
The moment it touched the street, the ground began shaking.
A gigantic mouth opened inside the cloud.
And it whispered,
“Thank you for raising me.”
Suddenly, every cloud in the sky opened its eyes.
They weren't clouds.
They were babies.
And their mother was coming to collect them.
